messages:
Alex (PM): Quick mid-quarter flipcheck — milestone 'Embed QoS & Routing' status pls. What actually shipped, what slipped, blockers, and who needs CR pings? I want a concise owner + next-step per item. @Priya can you start?

Priya (Eng): Shipped: prefix-KV caching prototype + internal perf tests (merged). PR: #4128.
Slipped: model-routing policy UI (was due last week) — UI work blocked by API changes. Owner: Priya -> next: unblock with eng-api.
Pending: quantization profile tests for Llama-2-13B -> need longer infra run. Owner: Jordan/Sam.
Pings: Jordan for quant tests, @Sam for benchmark harness, @Liam for infra slot.

Jordan (Eng): Ack. Quant tests running but failing mem-safety on batch size 32. Repro: run/bench/quant.sh --model 13b --bs 32 -> OOM on step 3. Might be kernel selection issue.
I can lower batch to 16 as mitigation, but that impacts throughput SLA. Need advice if we should ship with reduced batch.

Sam (Eng): Noted. I can tweak harness to do auto-batching fallback. Planning quick patch in PR #4134. That will keep latency under SLO with bs=16 while we debug kernel selection. Will request CR from Jordan + Priya.

Liam (SRE): Infra note: we have a maintenance window Thurs 09:00-11:00 UTC for the runtime kernel update. If quant job runs after that window, kernel-selection regression might be resolved. I can reserve a dedicated slot for 2 hours post-maintenance for extended runs.

Alex (PM): Helpful — thanks. Priya, timeline to unblock API change?

Priya (Eng): API change is a small compatibility tweak; I'm waiting on eng-api review (owner: Maya). I'll ping Maya now. ETA optimistic 24h if no major comments. If API lands, UI push can be in same sprint.

Jordan (Eng): Re: shipping: short-term plan: ship caching + perf improvements (already merged) and hold routing UI behind a feature flag until API lands. For quantization, ship experimental notes and opt-in config with bs=16 fallback. Will document perf delta.

Alex (PM): Sounds good. Can we get CR pings inline? Who will review PRs?

Priya (Eng): I'll request reviewers: @Jordan, @Sam for #4134 UI-client changes, and @Jordan for API integration tests once Maya merges.

Sam (Eng): I'll tag @Jordan and @Liam on #4134 for infra/ops implications. 

Jordan (Eng): I'll review #4134 tonight, aiming to approve by EOD PST.

CI Bot: buildbot: PR #4134 — integration tests started (job://ci/integration/1756).

Alex (PM): Outstanding blockers summary for my tracking: 1) API review (Maya) — blocks routing UI; 2) Quant kernel OOM — temporary bs=16 fallback, full fix post-kernel update; 3) Infra maintenance allocation (Liam) — reserved. Please update this thread when PRs move and when CI finishes.

Priya (Eng): Updated: pinged Maya, marked UI behind feature-flag in the roadmap doc.

CI Bot: buildbot: PR #4134 — integration tests passed (job://ci/integration/1756) :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Eng): Approved #4134. Merging after CI green.

Sam (Eng): Merged and deployed to staging. Running extended quant tests in reserved slot tomorrow after maintenance.

Liam (SRE): Confirmed slot reserved Thu 11:15-13:15 UTC. I'll put a calendar invite and ops-channel note.

Alex (PM): Great. I'll mark milestone partial-ship (caching + opt-in quant fallback) and schedule a follow-up retro next week to cover full routing UI ship plan. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
